status.decider: Funding carry (delta-neutral)

idea.name: Funding carry (delta-neutral)
idea.blurb: Hyperliquid perps vs spot · collects funding · market-neutral · kill 95%
idea.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, 'Crypto Carry' (BIS WP 1087 / Management Science); Hyperliquid funding docs
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for coins whose 7-day average funding is above 15% a year (up to 6, richest first), buy spot and short the same amount of perp; keep while funding stays above 5%. Price moves cancel, the book earns the funding longs pay shorts.

backtest.caveat: Sharpe is flattered by the smooth hourly premium used as the basis proxy; real risks are tail events (short-squeeze margin calls, venue risk) and a yield that has been shrinking.

boost.why: spot-funded delta-neutral: spot cannot be levered and the book is already fully deployed - fresh $10k only

status.decider: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral)

idea.name: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Altcoins priced in BTC · trend-following · BTC-hedged, beta ~0 · BOOSTED x5 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen, 'Time series momentum' (JFE 2012); Menkhoff et al., 'Currency momentum strategies' (JFE 2012); Liu & Tsyvinski, 'Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency' (RFS 2021)
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for each altcoin, price it in BTC and average the trend sign over 10/20/42/84 days (-1..+1). Long the alt perp when its BTC cross trends up, short when it trends down, sized to 20% vol per cross / 21 alts; the BTC perp takes the opposite of the net alt exposure (market-neutral).

backtest.caveat: Weak edge: the direction calls beat random ones (p=0.03) but the Sharpe interval includes zero and the last two years were flat (Sharpe -0.06). On probation - it earns its place on paper or gets retired. Uses only ~36% of the book gross, so returns are small by design.

boost.why: backtest: x5 -> 7.9%/yr, max DD 48.1% (growth peak x4.5 = 7.9%/yr)

status.decider: Vol-managed crypto momentum v2 (market-neutral, bear-market guard)

idea.name: Vol-managed crypto momentum v2 (market-neutral, bear-market guard)
idea.blurb: Weekly winners minus losers · sized by momentum's own recent volatility · BOOSTED x5 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025; Barroso & Santa-Clara, 'Momentum has its moments', JFE 2015
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: rank coins by 30-day return (skip the latest day); long the top fifth, short the bottom fifth, equal weight; scale the book by 20% / its own realised vol over the last 8 weeks (max 2x); v2: flat while the equal-weight coin index is down over the last 60 days.

backtest.caveat: On probation. The paper's key claim - that volatility scaling improves crypto momentum - did NOT replicate on our coins (scaled 0.51 vs unscaled 0.66). The winner/loser picks beat random ones only weakly (p=0.07), the Sharpe interval includes zero, and it lost money in 2025 and 2026. Backtest drawdown 42.5% would have tripped this book's 30% kill switch in 2025.

boost.why: backtest: x5 -> 50.6%/yr, max DD 73.2% (growth peak x5 = 50.6%/yr)

status.decider: Breakout Rocket v2: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged, BTC-regime gated)

idea.name: Breakout Rocket v2: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged, BTC-regime gated)
idea.blurb: Nine channel breakouts per coin · trailing stops · only while BTC is above its 100-day average · 80% vol, up to 4x · BOOSTED x2.25 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon, 'Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins', SSRN 5209907 (2025): Donchian ensemble over nine horizons, BTC net Sharpe 1.56, CAGR 30%, max DD 19% at a 25% vol target; top-20 rotation ~11%/yr alpha over BTC
idea.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: for each coin run nine breakout systems (5-360 days): long on a close above the prior L-day high, out on a close below the trailing channel midpoint. Signal = share of systems long, counted only while BTC closes above its 100-day average (v2); size by 1/60-day vol; scale the book to 80%/yr vol, max 4x gross.

backtest.caveat: v2 (2026-10-07) adds a BTC 100-day-average gate: 50-125 days all helped, 150-200 hurt, so the gate works only while it is fast - a choice made with hindsight on one 6-year history. v1: Max risk by design: at this setting the backtest fell 82.5% peak-to-trough and lost 24.5% over the last 12 months (BTC -28.5%); returns stop growing above ~80-100% vol, so this is the top of the dial, not a step on the way up. The kill switch fires at -85%. Coins are today's Hyperliquid survivors, which flatters a long-only result. 0.83 correlated with Strategy 1. The long/short version did NOT replicate (Sharpe 0.78, short leg -12%/yr), so it is long-only.

boost.why: backtest: x2.25 -> 299.2%/yr, max DD 96.3% (growth peak x1.75 = 332.3%/yr)

status.decider: 52-week-high momentum (market-neutral)

idea.name: 52-week-high momentum (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Long the coins pinned near their yearly high · short the ones far below it · BOOSTED x2.75 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: George & Hwang, 'The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing', Journal of Finance 59(5) 2004; Ficura, 'Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal', Prague University of Economics and Business WP 2023/5
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: PTH = last close / 52-week high for coins with a full year of data; long the top 30% by PTH, short the bottom 30%, equal weight, 0.5x equity per side.

backtest.caveat: Picks beat random coin picks (p=0.02) and ranking by the 52-week high beats ranking by the 52-week return (-0.13), as the paper predicts, and it hedges Strategy 1 (corr -0.42). But the Sharpe interval includes zero, the walk-forward that re-picks the lookback each quarter made only 0.22, it leans short the market (corr -0.51 with the equal-weight basket), and funding before Oct 2024 is missing from the history.

boost.why: backtest: x2.75 -> 16.2%/yr, max DD 60.5% (growth peak x2.25 = 17.2%/yr)

status.decider: Winners vs Bitcoin v2 (alt momentum, BTC-hedged, bear-market guard)

idea.name: Winners vs Bitcoin v2 (alt momentum, BTC-hedged, bear-market guard)
idea.blurb: Buys the strongest alts · shorts only Bitcoin as the hedge · an alt-season catcher (probation) · BOOSTED x2.75 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Fieberg, Liedtke & Zaremba, 'Cryptocurrency anomalies and economic constraints', International Review of Financial Analysis 94 (2024); Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: buy the 30% of altcoins with the best 28-day return (equal weight, 1x equity) and short BTC perp for their combined 90-day beta to BTC. Never shorts an altcoin. v2: flat while the equal-weight coin index is down over the last 60 days.

idea.name: Coskewness: paid to hold the alts that hate Bitcoin's big swings (1x, probation)
idea.blurb: Measures how each alt fares when Bitcoin makes a big move, up or down (180 days) · long the 4 that suffer most, short the 4 that love the swings · weekly · dollar-neutral · 1x
idea.source: Harvey & Siddique, 'Conditional skewness in asset pricing tests', Journal of Finance 55(3) 2000; crypto: Liu & Chen, 'Skewness risk and the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns', IRFA 96 (2024)
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: Harvey-Siddique coskewness of each alt with BTC over 180 daily returns; long the 4 lowest, short the 4 highest, 1/8 each, hold a week, 1x.

backtest.period: Jan 2022 - Oct 2026 (walk-forward, out of sample); full sample from Jun 2021
backtest.risk_dial: full sample: 0.5x 2.3%/yr DD 27% · 1x 3.3%/yr DD 49% (live, growth peak) · 1.5x 2.9%/yr DD 65% · 2x 1.2%/yr DD 77%; last 2 years 1x: 35.6%/yr DD 19%
backtest.caveat: PROBATION: over the full sample this is NOT an edge (pre-registered Sharpe 0.25, walk-forward 0.15, placebo p=0.13, gone if entered a day late). It has only worked since 2024 (last 2 years Sharpe 1.43, all 9 settings 0.68-1.58) - maybe a new regime as crypto institutionalised, maybe luck. Live because it is the only candidate today that is uncorrelated with every other book (|corr| <= 0.19) and still positive recently; kill switch 40%.

scene.title: Coskewness: who loves Bitcoin's big swings

ideas.name: Basis-Momentum: rising premium long, falling premium short (1x, probation) - Strategy 27
ideas.source: Boons & Prado, 'Basis-Momentum', Journal of Finance 74(1) 2019 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.12738); Chi, Hao, Hu & Ran, J. Futures Markets 43(8) 2023
ideas.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: BM = 7-day mean hourly perp premium minus the same mean 4 weeks earlier; long the 30% highest BM, short the 30% lowest, equal weight, dollar-neutral, 1x; hold a week.
ideas.verdict: Sharpe -0.29 (CI -1.94..1.28), -5.9%/yr, DD 23.5% at 1x Nov 2024-Oct 2026; gross 0.07, walk-forward -0.11, placebo p 0.46; correlation with live books <=0.18 - no edge shown, probation at 1x with 30% kill.

ideas.name: Absorption Ratio: out of crypto when coins move as one (3x) - Strategy 28
ideas.source: Kritzman, Li, Page & Rigobon, 'Principal Components as a Measure of Systemic Risk', Journal of Portfolio Management 37(4) 2011 - https://doi.org/10.3905/jpm.2011.37.4.112
ideas.rule: Daily: AR = top 1/5 eigenvalues / trace of 500-day EW (half-life 250) covariance of 22 perps; shift = (15d mean AR - 1y mean AR)/1y std; >= +1 cash, <= -1 100% equal-weight long basket, else 50%; 3x.
ideas.verdict: Sharpe 1.01 (CI -0.01..2.04) vs 0.52 for the basket, 34.8%/yr at 1x (66%/yr, 88% max DD at the live 3x), timing beats constant exposure by 21%/yr, placebo p=0.07, walk-forward 0.34 - promising, not proven.

ideas.name: Gold vs Bitcoin dual momentum (Quantpedia, Apr 2026)
ideas.rule: Weekly: hold BTC or gold (PAXG perp) whichever has the higher positive 4/8/12-week return, else cash.
ideas.verdict: Not tested: no gold daily history before Oct 2024 is reachable from the research machine (Massive gives 2 years; Hyperliquid/Yahoo/Stooq/LBMA blocked), too short for a weekly switching rule. Revisit if PAXG history is added.

ideas.name: Network momentum: peers' momentum through a positive residual-correlation graph (weekly 4 v 4)
ideas.source: Pu, Roberts, Dong & Zohren, 'Network Momentum across Asset Classes' (2023) - https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11294; Guo, Hardle & Tao, 'A Time-Varying Network for Cryptocurrencies' - https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.11921
ideas.rule: Mondays: A = max(0, 90-day corr of market-demeaned daily returns), row-normalised; signal = A x (L-day demeaned return / 90-day vol), L in 14/28/56; long top 4, short bottom 4.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe 0.18-0.21 for all three lookbacks vs 0.51-0.79 for each coin's own momentum - the network adds nothing in 22 coins.

ideas.name: Turn-of-the-month Bitcoin (hold last day + first 3 days of each month)
ideas.source: crypto calendar-anomaly literature (e.g. Baur, Cahill, Godfrey & Liu 2019, Finance Research Letters)
ideas.rule: Long BTC perp from the close two days before month end to the close of day 3, flat otherwise.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe 0.08; BTC averaged +7 bp/day on turn-of-month days vs +14 bp on the rest.

ideas.name: Low nominal price long/short (weekly 4 v 4)
ideas.source: Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu, 'Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency', Journal of Finance 77(2) 2022 - https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.13119
ideas.rule: Mondays: long the 4 lowest-priced coins, short the 4 highest, 1/8 each.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: Sharpe 0.77 but K=6 gives 0.09, 2025 -0.91, last 2 years 0.36; unit price has no economic story among 22 large coins (dollar-volume size proxy was 0.1).

ideas.name: Learned technical analysis: expanding-window regression on 2/4/10/20-week MA ratios (BTC and a 22-coin panel)
ideas.source: Detzel, Liu, Strauss, Zhou & Zhu, 'Learning and predictability via technical analysis: Evidence from bitcoin and stocks with hard-to-value fundamentals', Financial Management 50(1) 2021 - https://doi.org/10.1111/fima.12310
ideas.rule: Weekly: pooled OLS of next-week log return on log(price/MA_n), n = 2,4,10,20 weeks, fitted on all past weeks; position = sign of forecast (long/short or long-only, optional vol scaling).
ideas.verdict: Rejected: 22-coin panel net Sharpe -0.42 to 0.06 from 2022; BTC-only long-only 0.90 (L/S 0.60) but that is one more BTC trend book next to S1/S14/S22.

ideas.name: MAX momentum: long the coins with the biggest single up-day of the past month (weekly 4 v 4)
ideas.source: Li, Urquhart, Wang & Zhang, 'MAX momentum in cryptocurrency markets', International Review of Financial Analysis 77 (2021) 101829 - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.irfa.2021.101829
ideas.rule: Mondays: MAX = highest daily return of the last 28 days; long top 4, short bottom 4, 1/8 each, hold a week.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: Sharpe 0.89 (CI 0.10-1.53, placebo p=0.01) is 2021 (+321%); walk-forward 0.15, last 2 years -0.81, 0.62 correlated with plain momentum and only 0.26 once momentum is removed.

ideas.name: Crowded & breaking: short high-funding coins whose price is falling (cross-sectional)
ideas.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, 'Crypto carry', BIS Working Paper 1087 (2023) - https://www.bis.org/publ/work1087.htm
ideas.rule: Mondays: score = rank(7-day return) - rank(7-day mean funding); long top 4, short bottom 4.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe -0.03 over the 2 years of funding history.

ideas.name: Coskewness: paid to hold the alts that hate Bitcoin's big swings (1x, probation) - Strategy 29
ideas.source: Harvey & Siddique, 'Conditional skewness in asset pricing tests', Journal of Finance 55(3) 2000 - https://doi.org/10.1111/0022-1082.00247; Liu & Chen, IRFA 96 (2024) - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.irfa.2024.103626
ideas.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: Harvey-Siddique coskewness of each alt with BTC over 180 daily returns (pre-registered 90); long the 4 lowest, short the 4 highest, 1/8 each, hold a week, 1x.
ideas.verdict: Probation: no full-sample edge (pre-registered Sharpe 0.25, CI -0.57..1.13, walk-forward 0.15, placebo p=0.13) but 1.43 (CI 0.17..2.60, 35.6%/yr, DD 19%) over the last 2 years, all 9 settings 0.68-1.58, and uncorrelated with every other book (-0.19..+0.02).
